prior_credit.earlier_body_candidate: p171 C was already visible in an unreviewed OCR-derived candidate. The p172 E earlier 235-slot stream produced no such coherent Nov10 reading.
prior_credit.new_contribution: Source-exact retranscription of both physical witnesses, quantified alignment, source-supported reconciliation and repair-minimum certificate. All reconstructed coordinates are observed in at least one witness.
prior_credit.bounded_prior_body_check: The cached complete 2017 discussion did not identify these C/E bodies. Lasry et al. section 6.4 discusses a separate p172 C/p175 A family mentioning von Weiher, which retains its prior body attribution. That contextual name is not claimed as a new individual identification here. No universal decipherment priority claim is made.

assumptions.kind: same 252-coordinate message under the unchanged Nov10-12 key; p172 E lacks its first ten coordinates
assumptions.limits: The ten-coordinate leading loss is a same-message model supported by long ciphertext agreement and the source jammed marker; E has no legible advertised total. Other unknown original lengths are not globally excluded.

minimum_reconciliation.limits: The minimum is for reconciliation of these two aligned streams as one message. There are2048 minimum-cost common coordinate streams, not a unique plaintext. No original-length exclusion or statistical significance is claimed.

limits: The ten missing E prefix coordinates are inferred under the same-message alignment; E has an unread length header and does not explicitly print a ten-coordinate gap.
All chosen coordinate values are witnessed, but choosing among eleven conflicts uses the proposed readable body. Minimal repair count does not prove uniquely historical wording.
The anomalous INSP1IN and literal HPTVXX are preserved. No separator correction or key relabelling is introduced.
The two receiving timestamps are retained even though their order does not establish an actual relay sequence.
The source name WEIHER is supported by E's observed coordinate. Identification with a particular historical officer is not certified here.
